article.title: Edmonton bleg
article.excerpt: I'll have a free day there Saturday. What should I do, where should I go, and what/where should I eat? As always I thank you in advance for the suggestions; they do guide my decision-making. It is one of my goals to visit the fifteen or so of the largest metropolitan areas in Canada , plus (maybe) Regina and Saskatoon.
